In Table 5, the **Transformer without pre-training** has an average score of **59.9**. The variant with the **highest average** is the **Transformer without the auxiliary LM objective (w/o aux LM), at 75.0** (page 8).

The full model with the auxiliary LM objective averages 74.7, so it is slightly lower than the variant without the auxiliary objective. The LSTM with auxiliary LM averages 69.1 (page 8).

The authors explain the result this way. The auxiliary objective helps on the NLI tasks and QQP, and "larger datasets benefit from the auxiliary objective but smaller datasets do not" (page 8). They also say that removing pre-training "hurts performance across all the tasks, resulting in a 14.8% decrease compared to our full model" (page 8).
